summary: Verified magic-link login flow after removal of localStorage.setItem('session_token', ...) from MagicLink.jsx. 8/8 backend tests pass and Playwright E2E confirms cookie-only auth is fully load-bearing. localStorage is empty after magic-link consumption; /api/auth/me, /api/archive, /api/abilities, /api/agent/kinds all return 200 via the httpOnly session cookie alone. Unauth requests correctly return 401; magic-link reuse correctly returns 410; malformed token returns 400; unknown token returns 404. The removed localStorage write had zero readers (grep confirmed) and its removal did not break any flow.

notes: In React dev/StrictMode the MagicLink useEffect fires twice, causing POST /api/auth/magic/{token} to be called twice — second call returns 410 (already used). First call already sets the cookie and hydrates auth, so behavior is correct in production (StrictMode double-invoke does not happen in prod builds). Optional hardening: use a useRef guard in MagicLink.jsx to prevent the second POST in dev to silence the 410 in console. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Guard MagicLink.jsx useEffect with a useRef to prevent the harmless double-consume 410 caused by React StrictMode in dev.
critical_code_review_comments: Magic-link consume endpoint is not idempotent — one-shot by design (correct security posture). The frontend should therefore guard against StrictMode double-invocation with a ref to avoid a spurious 410 in dev consoles.

Removal of the localStorage.setItem('session_token', ...) is confirmed safe: zero readers exist in /app/frontend/src (grep). Auth is entirely cookie-based via withCredentials:true; XSS exposure surface reduced.
test_credentials: Seeded per test via mongosh recipe in /app/memory/test_credentials.md — magic_links doc + users doc inserted directly, cleaned up in fixture teardown.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a fresh test user + magic_links doc; the fixture cleans up users, magic_links, and user_sessions after the test module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 30 verified: MagicLink.jsx localStorage removal is safe; cookie auth (withCredentials:true) is load-bearing for all protected APIs. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration30_magic_link.py is a reusable regression harness for the magic-link + cookie-auth path.
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a false-positive code review; only the single localStorage.setItem write was removed. Verified end-to-end that no reader depended on it.
